distinct_id.comment: Stable pseudonymous VS Code machine identifier used to distinguish installations without collecting personal data.

$process_person_profile.comment: Always false so PostHog does not create or update person profiles.

extension.comment: Short emitting extension name, always sfmc-devtools.

extension.activated.comment: Emitted once after extension initialization with project and related-extension presence booleans.

isDevToolsProject.comment: Whether the workspace contains an mcdev project.

coInstalledAsDependency.comment: Whether another installed extension lists this extension as a dependency.

coInstalledInPack.comment: Whether another installed extension includes this extension in its pack.

neighbor.xnerd.ampscript-language.comment: Whether xnerd.ampscript-language is installed in the current extension host, regardless of activation.

neighbor.esbenp.prettier-vscode.comment: Whether esbenp.prettier-vscode is installed in the current extension host, regardless of activation.

neighbor.dbaeumer.vscode-eslint.comment: Whether dbaeumer.vscode-eslint is installed in the current extension host, regardless of activation.

neighbor.MarketingThibs.ampscriptsnippet.comment: Whether MarketingThibs.ampscriptsnippets is installed in the current extension host, regardless of activation.

mcdev.version.comment: Emitted once per session after the mcdev CLI version lookup settles.

mcdevVersion.comment: Installed mcdev CLI version, omitted when lookup fails or returns no version.

command.executed.comment: Emitted when an mcdev-run command reports a successful result.

command.failed.comment: Emitted when an mcdev-run command reports failure; no raw error message, stack, or path is collected.

errorCategory.comment: Coarse fixed failure category: commandFailed when mcdev reports failure, unknown when execute throws. Never a raw error value.

errorName.comment: Optional. Short Error.name identifier when it matches a safe pattern. Never a message.

errorCode.comment: Optional. Sanitized error.code (ENOENT, FileNotFound) as a string. Never a path.
